messages:
cory: Quick check — I'm switching order-service and billing-service from in-cluster Kubernetes Secrets to ExternalSecrets backed by Vault in a small TF change. Landing in a few minutes, want to make sure annotations / role mapping are correct. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4822

nisha: Which k8s namespaces are we changing? need to confirm the service account binding + vault role TTLs.

cory: order-service -> `orders-prod` and billing-service -> `billing-prod`. Using the existing vault auth/kubernetes role per-team but creating new `secret_templates` to extract kv pairs instead of whole secret blobs.

alex: quick skim — two things: 1) external-secrets expects the Vault KV v2 payload under `data.data` unless you use the template to map. 2) we should keep rotation jitter so not all secrets get churned at once.

maria: examples of the terraform change? small snippet would help to validate policy names.

cory: paste terraform snippet and the ES yaml I plan to generate:
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_secret" "order_db" {
  metadata { name = "order-db-creds" namespace = "orders-prod" }
  data = { username = var.db_user, password = var.db_pass }
}
# replacing with ExternalSecret resource below via k8s_manifest module
```
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: order-db-creds
  namespace: orders-prod
  annotations:
    external-secrets.io/refresh-interval: "60s"
spec:
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-cluster
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: order-db-creds
    creationPolicy: Owner
  data:
    - secretKey: username
      remoteRef:
        key: secret/data/orders/order-service
        property: username
    - secretKey: password
      remoteRef:
        key: secret/data/orders/order-service
        property: password
```
\ninfra-bot: CI check for PR 4822: terraform fmt ✅, plan -> warnings about policy `orders-app-read` access to `secret/data/*` ⚠️

nisha: That plan warning is expected if policy is broad. Suggest tightening to `secret/data/orders/*` and then bind the k8s role to the svc account used by the ES controller in that namespace. Example vault role command:
```
vault write auth/kubernetes/role/orders-extsecrets \
  bound_service_account_names=external-secrets-controller \
  bound_service_account_namespaces=orders-prod \
  policies=orders-app-read \
  ttl=24h
```

alex: Also add an annotation in the ExternalSecret to set `external-secrets.io/rotation-policy: staggered` (we use this informal key in a few places) or implement slightly different refresh-intervals per-namespace to avoid thundering herd. For Terraform, update `vault_policy` resource to use specific path and add `capabilities = ["read"]` only.

maria: One more gotcha — if you rely on template mapping make sure the template renders `data.data` for KVv2. Example snippet for template: 
```
template: |
  {{- with .RemoteData.data }}
  username: {{ .username }}
  password: {{ .password }}
  {{- end }}
```

cory: thanks — I'll tighten the policy and add the role binding command to the TF module. pinging @nisha and @alex for a quick review when I open the PR. Leaving refresh-interval at 60s for now for smoke testing, will widen to 5m for prod. :thumbsup:

nisha: Sounds good. If you can include smoke test steps in the PR description (how to validate creds rotation and rollback), I'll +1.

alex: I'll take a look in ~30m, focus on policy least-priv and SA binding.

cory: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4822 — added test steps + plan output, marked as WIP.

infra-bot: PR 4822 updated by cory — build queued.

maria: Quick note for runbooks: add a snippet to run `kubectl get secret -n orders-prod order-db-creds -o yaml` and `vault kv get secret/orders/order-service` to correlate values during smoke test.

cory: Will add to PR and post the test results here after the build. Thanks all!
